facts.statement: The Uncle-Sam summer items were only available in the Marketplace until 10 August 2011, after which they were no longer obtainable.
facts.quote: Ab Mittwoch, den 10. August 2011 sind sie nicht mehr erhältlich!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - ¿Qué novedades hay?
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post (page in Spanish chrome, body in German) announcing that the Uncle-Sam summer items would leave the Marketplace, with a deadline of Wednesday 10 August 2011. It lists the Uncle-Sam outfit pieces and three colored sparklers, marked (SC), and tells players to buy them from the Marketplace before then. The page does not state the item prices.
